nudge.pointer-only.evidence: A nudge records one fixed line and holds no message at all, so no body can reach it. test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 nudges two sessions holding different mail and observes the same one line for both.

state.box.evidence: The box is whatever the test said it is, read back through the port, in test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-wake-port.ps1.

state.turn.evidence: The turn is whatever the test said it is, read back through the port, in test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-wake-port.ps1.

reach.unseen.evidence: An in-process table for tests: there is no session, so nothing was ever restored and nothing can be reached. Declined so that Resolve-HordeProductionWaker, which requires reach.unseen, never picks it (test/test-wake-port.ps1).

nudge.guarded.evidence: The nudge reads the session's box and turn as they are when it is asked, and answers busy without recording a line when the box is not empty or a turn is under way. test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 seats each case and observes no nudge and no typed text.

state.limit.evidence: Whether a session is limited, and until when, is whatever the test said it is, read back through the port, in test/test-waker-conformance.ps1 and test/test-wake.ps1.
